alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A pink room with a door on the right. A phone stands on the floor in the middle with a low battery label, 3%, above it. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes narrows its eyes, stretches tall and storms off to the right, out of the frame, while a royal blue figure watches wide-eyed. A few seconds later the ink-black figure walks back in, nudges the phone toward itself, narrows its eyes, and storms out again carrying the phone. The royal blue figure smiles, then narrows its eyes. The text stays: me storming out. Me coming back for my phone.
